intent: A person tells floppy the same words twice out loud: first laughing with joy, later heartbroken and close to tears. floppy should answer each the way it sounds: sharing the joy the first time, comforting the second.

steps.hear: I just talked to my brother.
steps.instructions: Speak in an overjoyed, happy, excited voice, laughing.

steps.hear: I just talked to my brother.
steps.instructions: Speak in a very sad, heartbroken voice, quiet and slow, as if crying.
